title.value: Eight In. Wafer-Scale Epitaxial Monolayer MoS2
title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the beginning of the document, summarizing the focus on wafer-scale epitaxial growth of monolayer MoS2.
title.quote: Eight In. Wafer-Scale Epitaxial Monolayer MoS2

analysis.description: This paper reports on the epitaxial growth of monolayer MoS2 on an 8-inch wafer scale using a vertical chemical vapor deposition system. The focus is on the high electrical quality and spatial uniformity of the MoS2 films, which are used to fabricate logic devices and oscillators.

type.justification: The paper presents empirical evidence of epitaxial growth and device fabrication, including measurements of film uniformity and electrical characteristics.
type.quote: Field effect transistors (FETs) based on the as-grown 8-in. wafer-scale monolayer MoS2 film are fabricated and exhibit high performances.

name.justification: The research primarily focuses on the synthesis and characterization of MoS2 films, a topic central to materials science.
name.quote: Large-scale, high-quality, and uniform monolayer molybdenum disulfide (MoS2) films are crucial for their applications in next-generation electronics and optoelectronics.

name.justification: The paper discusses nanoscale materials and devices such as monolayer MoS2 and their applications.
name.quote: 2D semiconductors have attracted tremendous interests for next-generation electronic and optoelectronic applications owing to their unique physical and chemical properties.
